title: (Updated) Notice: The July 2026 Scan Cab for Microsoft updates is delayed
body:
Updated July 14, 2026: The July 2026 Scan Cab is now available as of 2:00 PM PDT.
Note: This notice only affects environments where Scan Cab is used to check for Microsoft update compliance.
What and why:The Scan Cab for the July 2026 Microsoft security updates is currently delayed and has not yet been released.
Rollout schedule:We estimate it will be released later today, and we will communicate an update as more information becomes available. Thank you for your patience.
Who is affected:IT administrators who rely on Scan Cab to check for update compliance can monitor our communications for updates.
What will happen:Updates on the availability of this month's Scan Cab will be communicated as new information becomes available. Additional information:- Learn more about the Scan Cab process: Announcing a smaller WSUS Scan Cab- Use Windows Update Agent (WUA) to scan computers for security updates without connecting to Windows Update: Using WUA to Scan for Updates Offline - Win32 apps- Documentation on the Catalog Site used to import updates and drivers: WSUS and the Catalog Site
bodyHtml:
Updated July 14, 2026: The July 2026 Scan Cab is now available as of 2:00 PM PDT.


Note: This notice only affects environments where Scan Cab is used to check for Microsoft update compliance.


What and why:

The Scan Cab for the July 2026 Microsoft security updates is currently delayed and has not yet been released.


Rollout schedule:

We estimate it will be released later today, and we will communicate an update as more information becomes available. Thank you for your patience.


Who is affected:

IT administrators who rely on Scan Cab to check for update compliance can monitor our communications for updates.


What will happen:

Updates on the availability of this month's Scan Cab will be communicated as new information becomes available.

 

Additional information:

  • Learn more about the Scan Cab process: Announcing a smaller WSUS Scan Cab
  • Use Windows Update Agent (WUA) to scan computers for security updates without connecting to Windows Update: Using WUA to Scan for Updates Offline - Win32 apps
  • Documentation on the Catalog Site used to import updates and drivers: WSUS and the Catalog Site
